The world’s coldest liquid is far stranger than you’d imagine. Sponsored by Ground News - Go to https://ground.news/Ve and subscribe to get 40% off the unlimited access Vantage Plan. Stay informed on breaking news and compare coverage from every angle.

If you’re looking for a molecular modelling kit, try Snatoms, a kit I invented where the atoms snap together magnetically - https://ve42.co/SnatomsV 

Sign up for the Veritasium newsletter for weekly science updates - https://ve42.co/Newsletter

Join our Patreon for a chance to get a NASA sticker that went to the edge of space during the eclipse and for early access to work-in-progress videos https://ve42.co/VePatreon

Last year, we launched Elements of Truth on Kickstarter. We’re now in the final stages of production, and Kickstarter rewards are shipping soon. If you missed the campaign, you can now pre-order the retail edition through our new website here - https://ve42.co/YTDEcl  
If you backed us on Kickstarter, don’t worry, your game will ship before any pre-orders are fulfilled.

▀▀▀
Chapters: 
0:00 The "Impossible" Liquid
1:59 The Race to Absolute Zero
6:33 Why Helium Seemed Impossible to Liquefy
15:04 The First Liquid Helium Ever Made
19:08 Can you make solid helium?
21:42 What is superconductivity?
28:41 Zero Viscosity and Superfluidity
36:15 What are Bose-Einstein condensates?
43:20 How Kapitsa Saved Landau From Prison
46:20 The Superfluid Fountain Powered by Light
47:46 Landau's Theory of Phonons
58:32 Why Helium (Almost) Never Freezes
1:01:58 The takeaway

▀▀▀
A big thank you to Prof. Dirk van Delft for his guidance and expertise on Onnes’ life and work. If you want to read more about it you can find the free PDF of his book “Freezing Physics” here:  https://ve42.co/Freezing_physics 
A massive thank you to Prof. Martin Zwierlein for his enthusiasm and helping us get the specifics of superfluidity and BECs right.
As well as a huge thank you to everyone who helped us understand the physics, the story, and provided valuable feedback on different parts of this video: Prof. Kostas Gavroglu, Dr. Philippe Lebrun, Prof. David Kaiser, Dr. John G Weisend II, Prof. Ad Maas, and Prof Robert Taylor.
Then two more special thank-you’s:
The first is to Rijksmuseum Boerhaave, for showing us around the archives and Onnes’ original equipment. You can check them out here: https://www.rijksmuseumboerhaave.nl/ 
And the second, of course, is to everyone at the Gravity Laboratory and Nottingham University who recreated all the experiments for us. Your efforts made this video possible. Dr. Chris Goodwin, thank you for your unrelenting support in helping us get the physics of superfluidity right. You can check out the gravity laboratory here: ve42.co/GravityLaboratory

▀▀▀
References: https://ve42.co/SuperfluidsReferences

There was a lot of talk about communism on the campaign trail for the 2026 midterm elections. Trump and the right worked to convince voters that candidates associated with the Democratic Socialists of America — and by extension the entire Democratic Party — had communist tendencies. 

As 2026 midterm votes are still being counted, DSA candidates have had a strong showing across the country, capturing electoral victories in several states. The Gen Z historian Kahlil Greene (@historycanthide)  explores the policies and ideas the DSA supports, and how it differs from the Communist Party of the USA (CPUSA) in the newest episode of our series, Kahlil, Explains.

Krishna Das, a celebrated musician and spiritual guide, reflects on his transformative journey with Neem Karoli Baba, sharing how his Guru's teachings profoundly influenced his life and music.

He recounts his time in India, especially in Kainchi, where chanting and devotion revealed profound spiritual truths. Despite facing personal struggles, including addiction and depression after his Guru's passing, Krishna Das found redemption through devotion and spiritual practices.

His music, rooted in bhakti (devotion), continues to inspire countless people, emphasizing the power of chanting to connect with the divine and achieve inner peace.
